Its exact acyclic greedy Morse matching has 336 pairs and residual cells 1 vertex, 5 degree-two, 24 degree-three, 12 degree-four; top Morse differential vanishes and 5x24 next differential has a unit 5x5 minor, yielding Z ranks 19,12 in degrees3,4. Original top boundary rank60 in dimension72 leaves 12 top rational cycles. Signed action of all 72 automorphisms produces H3 traces (19,1,1,3,1,1,-1,1,-1) and H4 (12,0,0,0,0,6,-2,0,-2) on nine classes. Standard S3 wreath S2 character inner products give the listed seven and five unique irreducibles; H3^G dimension1, H4^G zero. This is a complete fixed finite calculation, not a family extrapolation. C PASS.
